entities.name: Thatu Reiniger
entities.description: Powerful, manipulative vampire lord and wielder of the Bloodletter on Innistrad; killed by Raben Amsel.

entities.name: The Bloodletter
entities.description: Cursed sword that causes eternal bleeding in mortals and final death to vampires.

entities.name: Reika Eberhardt
entities.description: Former initiate of the church who lured Thatu with the promise of the Bloodletter.

entities.name: Pitre the Thatcher
entities.description: Countryman turned vampire hunter, betrothed to Lorelei Garensun, outmatched by Thatu.

entities.name: Raben Amsel
entities.description: Cathar adept sent to retrieve the Bloodletter, who defeated Thatu.

entities.name: Jofridus
entities.description: Father of Raben Amsel, doomed by the sword.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane where these events take place.

events.summary: Reika Eberhardt lures Thatu with the promise of the Bloodletter.
events.quote: lured him with the promise of this potent relic

events.summary: Pitre trains to hunt Thatu but is outmatched, leading to his end and a curse upon his village.
events.quote: Pitre was ultimately outmatched, leading to his tragic end and a curse upon his village.

events.summary: Raben Amsel is dispatched to retrieve the Bloodletter.
events.quote: was dispatched to retrieve The Bloodletter
In a climactic battle, Amsel managed to defeat Thatu

events.summary: Thatu warns Amsel that the sword will bring doom to Jofridus, which proves true.
